description: List the files and folders in a directory on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Use this to explore the server's filesystem before reading or editing anything. Long listings come back in pages of 250 files and 250 folders: when `truncated` is true, call again with `offset` set to `next_offset`, or use search_files to find something specific.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

offset.description: Entries to skip, from a previous call's `next_offset`.

path.description: Directory to list, from the instance root. Defaults to "/".

name: list_files
title: List Files
